WITH event_rates AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.type,
        AVG(1.0 * b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS event_rate
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type
),
type_rates AS (
    SELECT type, AVG(event_rate) AS average_spending_rate
    FROM event_rates
    GROUP BY type
)
SELECT
    type,
    average_spending_rate,
    average_spending_rate / NULLIF(AVG(average_spending_rate) OVER (), 0) AS rate_vs_simple_mean
FROM type_rates;

assumptions.assumption: A budget line with amount 0 has an undefined spending rate, so it is excluded from averages, as are missing values.
